Examples / Rule: View, open, click, start, submit, claim, request, opt in.
Analytics Treatment: Measure discovery, intent, interaction and funnel progression.
Evidence Status: Proposed taxonomy; not evidence of deployed instrumentation.

Definition: A backend/system state transition or processing result.
Examples / Rule: Validated, accepted, rejected, queued, credited, reversed, settled, expired, failed.
Analytics Treatment: Measure processing, reliability, lifecycle transitions and operational outcomes.
Evidence Status: Proposed taxonomy; implementation must be confirmed by engineering.

Definition: A governed result derived from one or more events/records.
Examples / Rule: Verified activation, completed task, net reward credited, successful withdrawal, qualified referral.
Analytics Treatment: Calculate from authoritative state/ledger records; avoid counting raw clicks as outcomes.
Evidence Status: Proposed metric definition; requires owner approval and authoritative source.

Definition: One product workflow can contain all three classes.
Examples / Rule: Do not label a user click as a business outcome. A business outcome needs an explicit success rule and authoritative record.
Analytics Treatment: Preserve event_class and outcome_status separately where a single event could otherwise conflate them.

Definition: Use past-tense snake_case for emitted events; keep outcome definitions in KPI catalogue.
Analytics Treatment: Version event schemas and maintain backward-compatible changes.
